name: hister
one_liner: A private Google just for you: it remembers every web page and file you've looked at and lets you search all of it later, without sending your data to a big tech company.
buyer: A privacy-conscious independent researcher, journalist, or consultant who reads hundreds of sources and constantly can't find that one article again.
business_use_cases: A research consultant sells 'personal knowledge base setup' as a service to clients who read constantly and lose track of sources.
A small law firm runs a shared instance so every associate's browsing and case-file research becomes searchable across the team.
A journalist or analyst uses it to instantly recall a fact or quote from something they read weeks ago without re-Googling.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version for non-technical users who don't want to self-host.
Sell setup and support contracts to small teams (law firms, agencies) wanting a shared internal search tool.

steal_this: Host it for yourself this weekend, then offer to set it up for one busy professional friend (a lawyer, researcher, or writer) for a flat fee plus a small monthly hosting charge.
